C189.name: Zanzibar Municipal Council
C189.documented: urban and shore floods, large waves, strong winds, rare tsunami, boat accidents, and cholera

area.en: Zanzibar City: Stone Town and seafront
area.sw: Jiji la Zanzibar: Mji Mkongwe na ufukwe

risk.en: This area has old, densely packed coral-stone buildings and narrow lanes where heavy rain weakens walls, buildings can collapse, fires spread and storm tides hit the seafront.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina majengo ya zamani ya mawe ya matumbawe yaliyobanana na vichochoro vyembamba ambapo mvua kubwa hudhoofisha kuta, majengo yanaweza kuanguka, moto husambaa na mawimbi makubwa hupiga ufukwe.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it helps to report cracked or leaning buildings, keep lanes clear for fire and rescue and keep goods off the floor near the shore. What raises the risk: adding floors or water tanks to old coral-stone buildings without checking the walls, blocking the lanes with stalls and parked carts, running loose wiring between houses and ignoring new cracks. Agree with the household which open square or wide street you will move to if a wall cracks, fire starts or a storm-tide warning is given, and leave a building at once when it creaks or cracks widen in heavy rain. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kutoa taarifa za majengo yenye nyufa au yaliyoinama, kuacha vichochoro wazi kwa zimamoto na uokoaji na kuhifadhi bidhaa juu ya sakafu karibu na ufukwe. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuongeza ghorofa au matanki ya maji kwenye majengo ya zamani ya mawe ya matumbawe bila kukagua kuta, kuziba vichochoro kwa vibanda na mikokoteni, kuvuta nyaya zilizolegea kati ya nyumba na kupuuza nyufa mpya. Kubalianeni kama kaya uwanja au barabara pana mtakayohamia ukuta ukipasuka, moto ukianza au tahadhari ya mawimbi ya dhoruba ikitolewa, na tokeni jengoni mara moja linapotoa sauti au nyufa zikipanuka wakati wa mvua kubwa. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

area.sw: Mjini: mitaa ya chini na yenye msongamano

risk.en: This area has low-lying, crowded neighbourhoods such as Mwanakwerekwe and Kwahani where storm water floods homes, drains block and cholera spreads.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mitaa ya chini yenye msongamano kama Mwanakwerekwe na Kwahani ambapo maji ya dhoruba hufurika nyumba, mitaro huziba na kipindupindu husambaa.

advice.en: For those living here, it helps to keep drains free of waste, build on raised floors and use safe water and latrines. What raises the risk: building over the drains or in the natural water paths, filling them with waste, digging latrines in ground that floods and drawing water from shallow wells after a flood. Know the school, mosque or church on higher ground that is your assembly point, move there with children and the elderly when water enters the streets, and report the first case of watery diarrhoea the same day. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi hapa, ni vyema kuweka mitaro bila taka, kujenga sakafu zilizoinuliwa na kutumia maji salama na vyoo. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga juu ya mitaro au kwenye njia za asili za maji, kuijaza taka, kuchimba vyoo kwenye ardhi inayofurika na kuchota maji kwenye visima vifupi baada ya mafuriko. Fahamu shule, msikiti au kanisa lililo sehemu ya juu ambalo ni kituo chenu cha kukusanyika, hamieni huko na watoto na wazee maji yanapoingia mitaani, na ripoti mgonjwa wa kwanza wa kuharisha maji siku hiyo hiyo. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C190.name: Magharibi A District
C190.documented: coastal floods, large waves, heavy Vuli and Masika rain, and boat accidents

area.en: Magharibi A: coast and fast-growing settlements
area.sw: Magharibi A: pwani na makazi yanayokua kwa kasi

risk.en: This area has a coastline exposed to erosion and storm tides and fast-growing settlements built in natural water paths that flood in heavy rain.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina pwani inayoathiriwa na mmomonyoko na mawimbi makubwa na makazi yanayokua kwa kasi yaliyojengwa kwenye njia za asili za maji zinazofurika wakati wa mvua kubwa.

advice.en: For those living and building here, it helps to build outside water paths and back from the shore, and obtain building approval before building. What raises the risk and the loss when the plot floods: buying or building on plots in the natural water paths because they are cheap, filling the channels to make room, building on the beach front and mining sand from the shore. Before building, ask the sheha or the council where the water goes in a heavy storm; know the higher ground your household will move to when the channels overtop or a storm-tide warning is given. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kujenga hapa, ni vyema kujenga nje ya njia za maji na mbali na ufukwe, na kupata kibali cha ujenzi kabla ya kujenga. Kinachoongeza hatari na hasara kiwanja kinapofurika: kununua au kujenga kwenye viwanja ndani ya njia za asili za maji kwa sababu ni rahisi, kujaza mikondo kupata nafasi, kujenga ufukweni na kuchimba mchanga ufukweni. Kabla ya kujenga, ulizeni sheha au halmashauri maji huenda wapi dhoruba kali; fahamu eneo la juu ambalo kaya yako itahamia mikondo inapofurika au tahadhari ya mawimbi ya dhoruba inapotolewa. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C191.name: Magharibi B District
C191.documented: coastal floods, large waves, heavy rain, and boat accidents

area.en: Magharibi B: airport zone and coastal villages
area.sw: Magharibi B: eneo la uwanja wa ndege na vijiji vya pwani

risk.en: This area includes low ground near the airport and coastal villages where storm water ponds, the shore erodes and fishers face rough seas.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linajumuisha ardhi ya chini karibu na uwanja wa ndege na vijiji vya pwani ambapo maji ya dhoruba hutuama, ufukwe humomonyoka na wavuvi hukabiliwa na bahari chafu.

advice.en: For those living and fishing here, it helps to keep drains open, protect mangroves and stay ashore when strong winds are forecast. What raises the risk: building in the low ground that ponds, cutting mangroves for poles or plots, and going out in loaded boats when the wind is rising. Know the higher ground inland that your household will move to when the low ground floods or a storm-tide warning is given, and the sheltered landing boats will run to when the wind rises. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kuvua hapa, ni vyema kuweka mitaro wazi, kulinda mikoko na kubaki ufukweni upepo mkali unapotabiriwa. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga kwenye ardhi ya chini inayotuamisha maji, kukata mikoko kwa ajili ya nguzo au viwanja, na kutoka baharini kwa vyombo vilivyojaa upepo unapopanda. Fahamu eneo la juu la ndani ambalo kaya yako itahamia ardhi ya chini inapofurika au tahadhari ya mawimbi ya dhoruba inapotolewa, na mwalo uliokingwa ambao vyombo vitakimbilia upepo unapopanda. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.
